pwa_fullscreen.scope: Direct Node execution; browser and service-worker APIs represented by controlled VM test doubles. Native browser integration is reported separately.
checks: fullscreen is requested by a click and browser events synchronize every control
fullscreen denial opens dismissible help, stops movement and permits retry
iPhone without fullscreen receives honest Add to Home Screen instructions
accepted install prompt does not falsely report completed installation
dismissed install consumes the prompt and the next click offers manual help
standalone mode hides install affordances and worker only registers on secure origins
worker precaches only disconnected page and icons, and preserves unrelated caches
worker never intercepts game code, API, credential POST or cross-origin requests
navigation loads fresh HTML online and falls back to disconnected page offline

panel_lock.scope: Direct Node execution of production windows.js with a controlled DOM/storage/pointer fixture. Native mouse and touch integration is reported separately.
checks: new layouts start locked; pointer and keyboard cannot move panels
legacy saved positions and visibility survive default-lock migration
explicit unlock permits drag and arrow movement, and locking preserves placement
locking mid-drag releases capture and restores the last committed position
reset preserves current lock state while clearing positions and hidden panels
mobile unlock permits moving panels and relock preserves separate saved placement
only an explicit boolean false unlocks a stored profile

note: Direct Node execution in a single process; browser integration is reported separately.
